description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Beast], [Damage Cap +10000], [Combat Instant Cast] and [Celerity Instant Cast] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Beast
description.text: Combat and Celerity abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Combat and Celerity abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Combat Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Combat abilities

description.name: Celerity Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Celerity abilities
